name: taobao-mcp
description: Local Taobao and Tmall sourcing assistant with product research, seller messaging, cart staging, order tracking, and inventory exports.

interface.shortDescription: Research and manage Taobao sourcing locally
interface.longDescription: Use a visible local browser to search Taobao and Tmall, compare SKU-level pricing and reviews, draft gated seller replies, stage confirmed cart items, track orders, and export sourcing or inventory workbooks.
